authorization_change: Before this change the named package principal svc-irpt-packager (the only caller PACKAGE admits: the principal check, and the body firm bound to PACKAGE_ALLOWED_FIRMS, infra/aws/terraform/ticket-center/main.tf:266) could write the package member only -- the four pointers, the firm and the attach stamps -- on an open analysis_request whose requester firm equals the body firm. After this change the same principal, on the same tickets, may ALSO write the ticket's top-level report_ref = {request_id, revision, recorded_by, recorded_at} once, in the same write as the package, and only when the ticket holds no report_ref; it may re-send the same request_id (no write to report_ref) and may not replace a different one (409 REPORT_REF_ALREADY_RECORDED_OTHER). Not changed: the principal check, the firm checks, PACKAGE_ALREADY_ATTACHED, the pointer validation, every other route, the MATRIX, the authorizer, IAM and Terraform -- no Terraform or authorizer file is edited and none is required by this code (main.tf:258 and :266 carry the same firm lists and no new environment variable is read). Keys touched: the ticket item's top-level report_ref (a new write path; before this change only REPORT and CREATE-with-report_request_id wrote it) and events (one report_recorded row). Rollback: redeploy the previous ticket_center Lambda package version. The request_id and request_revision members are additive and absent from every current sender; a report_ref written by this path afterwards is an ordinary REPORT-shaped ref that the drafter reads, and no route removes it.
